experiment: P5u direct-child-supervised hash-pinned legacy-source-portable shared frozen-forward execution
research_question: With the P5t E-drive hash-pinned legacy source fix unchanged, can a supervisor directly track the actual P5s executor and complete the output-equivalent frozen-forward cost protocol?
single_changed_axis: Detached supervision topology only. P5u runs the P5t no-data source/checkpoint preflight inside its supervisor before spawning the unchanged P5s executor directly; the supervisor child PID and terminal receipt therefore refer to the actual executor.

legacy_source_contract.prelaunch_requirement: P5t self-test-frozen-models runs inside the direct supervisor before it creates the actual executor child.

historical_baseline_audit.rule: explicit baseline and every locally retained generated train MAT must be readable; overlap and unreadable counts must be zero

development_data.identity_rule: zero overlap with explicit baseline and every local generated train identity, including quarantined P5p/P5q/P5r/P5s/P5t

execution.benchmark_batch: first complete index-ordered batch, indices 0 through 125
execution.reference: two frozen base forwards plus unchanged dense attachment
execution.candidate: one frozen base forward plus identical unchanged dense attachment

detached_chunk_contract.analytic_chunk_rule: unchanged P5s chunk order and hashes
detached_chunk_contract.supervisor_rule: P5u supervisor records source preflight then directly spawns and waits for the actual P5s executor PID

checkpoint_contract.selection_prohibition: No completed timing/model unit may be selectively rerun.
checkpoint_contract.self_test: P5u synthetic preflight+direct-child terminal test, P5t frozen-model self-test, and P5s chunk tests pass before generation.

stop_rule: Any source preflight failure, direct-child receipt mismatch, audit failure, external CUDA Python process, missing terminal receipt, output non-equivalence or latency failure stops P5u with no identity reuse or tuning.

confirmation_if_and_only_if_development_.decision: Only fresh confirmation supports the narrow output-equivalent execution claim.
